report.incidentSummary: On the morning of 2026-10-14 starting around 09:10 IST (03:40 UTC), users reported that portfolio holdings and P&L for mutual funds showed stale values from the previous day (nav_date=2026-10-12), while stock holdings remained unaffected and no client-side errors were displayed.
report.rootCauseStatement: The scheduled nightly nav-import batch job in market-data-service aborted at 2026-10-13 18:02:06 UTC (23:32 IST) due to an unhandled parse error ('N.A.' NAV value for scheme code 118191 on line 8982 of NAVAll.txt). The parser aborted without writing any of the 14,231 NAVs and exited with code 1, leaving market-data-service serving 2026-10-12 NAVs. No automated retries or alerts triggered, causing nav_age_s to increase past 34 hours and forcing portfolio-service to fall back to the stale 2026-10-12 NAV dataset for mutual fund valuation.

hypotheses.cause: The nightly nav-import batch job in market-data-service aborted after encountering an unhandled 'N.A.' string value for scheme code 118191 on line 8982 of NAVAll.txt, writing 0 of 14,231 NAV records and leaving mutual fund NAVs stale at 2026-10-12 with no automated retries.
hypotheses.rationale: Direct log and metric evidence shows job-scheduler executed nav-import at 18:00 UTC, NAVAll.txt downloaded, but parsing failed at 18:02 UTC with an unhandled 'N.A.' value, aborting with 0 of 14,231 records committed and exit code 1. No retries were executed, and nav_age_s climbed monotonically to ~125,000s.

hypotheses.cause: Upstream amfi-nav-feed published malformed data containing the string 'N.A.' instead of a numeric NAV for scheme code 118191 in NAVAll.txt, violating downstream ingestion expectations.
hypotheses.rationale: AMFI's published file NAVAll.txt contained 'N.A.' on line 8982. While this triggered the incident, resilient ingestion pipelines in market-data-service should handle or skip missing NAV values rather than dropping the entire file of 14,231 records.

hypotheses.cause: Deployment CHG-48221 to portfolio-service at 03:40 UTC introduced a regression in the portfolio valuation calculation refactor.
hypotheses.rationale: portfolio-service was already logging warnings regarding stale NAVs (nav_date=2026-10-12) as early as 02:16 UTC, well before CHG-48221 was deployed at 03:40 UTC. Furthermore, stock price latency remained fresh (~2s) and nav_age_s had been rising since 18:02 UTC the prior evening.

facts.statement: At 2026-10-13 18:00:00 UTC (23:30 IST), job-scheduler triggered scheduled job 'nav-import' (run_7fadae4b).
market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed at 18:01:00 UTC without network or HTTP errors.

At 2026-10-13 18:02:00 UTC, nav-import threw a parse error on line 8982 ('invalid NAV value N.A. for scheme code 118191') and aborted at 18:02:06 UTC with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written, exiting with code 1 at 18:06:00 UTC.
No retry attempts or subsequent executions of nav-import were scheduled or run between 18:30 UTC on 2026-10-13 and 05:00 UTC on 2026-10-14.
market-data-service metric nav_age_s steadily increased from ~82,740s at 17:00 UTC on 2026-10-13 to 125,460s (~34.85 hours) at 04:55 UTC on 2026-10-14 without resetting.

portfolio-service logged repeated warnings starting at 02:16:24 UTC on 2026-10-14 stating that fund NAV was older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12) and fell back to displaying the last available NAV.
portfolio-service stock price metric price_age_s remained nominal at ~2s throughout the entire window.
Deployment CHG-48221 to portfolio-service was completed at 03:40:00 UTC on 2026-10-14.

inferences.statement: Mutual fund valuations displayed yesterday's values because the nightly batch failed to ingest the 2026-10-13 NAV feed, leaving market-data-service serving stale 2026-10-12 records.
The portfolio-service deployment CHG-48221 at 03:40 UTC was coincidental with morning user login traffic at 09:10 IST and was not the cause of stale mutual fund valuations.

assumptions.statement: The AMFI feed parser in market-data-service expects strictly numeric NAV strings and lacks non-fatal handling or schema sanitization for 'N.A.' strings.

timeline.event: job-scheduler triggers nightly job nav-import (run_7fadae4b).
market-data-service successfully downloads NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed.
nav-import encounters parse error at line 8982: invalid NAV value 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191.
nav-import aborts with 0 of 14,231 records written, retaining the 2026-10-12 NAV dataset.
job-scheduler records nav-import job failure with exit code 1; no retry is initiated.
portfolio-service begins logging warnings that fund NAVs are older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12) and falls back to last available NAV.
User traffic surges as market opens; users report stale mutual fund portfolio values. Concurrently, deployment CHG-48221 completes on portfolio-service.

confidence.rationale: Direct log traces and execution metrics confirm the exact failure point, the line number and invalid token in NAVAll.txt, the job exit code, and the monotonic rise in nav_age_s.

recommendedActions.action: Manually trigger nav-import in market-data-service with a patched parser or sanitized NAV file to ingest the latest AMFI NAVs immediately.
recommendedActions.rationale: Resolves current user impact by updating stale mutual fund NAVs from 2026-10-12 to the latest published figures.
recommendedActions.verification: Check market-data-service nav_age_s resets below 300s, and portfolio-service stops logging stale NAV fallback warnings.

recommendedActions.action: Update the NAV parser in market-data-service to gracefully handle non-numeric or 'N.A.' NAV values by logging a scheme-level warning and continuing the batch rather than aborting.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents a single invalid scheme entry from blocking ingestion of thousands of valid mutual fund NAV records.
recommendedActions.verification: Test nav-import against NAVAll.txt containing 'N.A.' strings and verify all valid records are committed successfully.

recommendedActions.action: Configure alert rules on nav-import job failure in job-scheduler and on nav_age_s exceeding threshold (e.g., > 24 hours).
recommendedActions.rationale: Ensures on-call engineers are alerted immediately when nightly imports fail rather than discovering stale data after market open.
recommendedActions.verification: Simulate job failure in staging and confirm alert notification triggers within 15 minutes.
